types.AppendVariable: Appends a value to an existing array variable
types.AzureHDInsight: Runs various programs (Hive, Pig, MapReduce, Streaming, Spark) on an Azure HDInsight cluster
types.AzureMLExecutePipeline: Executes Azure Machine Learning operations (batch execution, update resource, execute pipeline)
types.Copy: Copy Activity that copies data from a source to a destination
types.Custom: Azure Batch - Executes a custom activity with user-defined command
types.DataLakeAnalyticsScope: Runs a Scope script on Azure Data Lake Analytics
types.DatabricksNotebook: Executes Databricks operations (notebook, Spark JAR, Spark Python)
types.Delete: Deletes data from a data source
types.ExecutePipeline: Executes another pipeline as a nested activity
types.ExecuteSSISPackage: Executes a SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) package
types.Fail: Explicitly fails the pipeline with a specified error message
types.Filter: Filters an array based on a provided condition
types.ForEach: Iterates over a collection and executes activities for each item
types.GetMetadata: Retrieves metadata information from a data source
types.IfCondition: Executes activities based on a conditional expression
types.KustoQueryLanguage: Executes a KQL query on Azure Data Explorer
types.Lookup: Retrieves data from a data source for use in subsequent activities
types.MicrosoftTeams: Sends a message to Microsoft Teams
types.PBISemanticModelRefresh: Refreshes a Power BI semantic model
types.SetVariable: Sets the value of an existing variable
types.SqlServerStoredProcedure: Executes a stored procedure in SQL Server
types.Switch: Executes different activities based on a switch expression
types.Until: Repeats activities until a condition is met
types.Wait: Pauses the pipeline execution for a specified duration
types.WebActivity: Makes HTTP requests to external web services
types.WebHook: Calls a webhook and waits for a callback
